difficulty_reason: Verifies representability of h by the aut-iso lemmas, pulls the presentation back to an affine U', assembles the groupoids (U,R) and (U',R') with the three cartesian diagrams (two by transitivity, the stabilizer square by pulling back the inertia isomorphism), identifies M' -> M etale with U' = M' x_M U by the groupoids lemma, and concludes the groupoid base-changes so the moduli diagram is cartesian.
